summary: Braskem filed a Form 6-K notifying shareholders of a late replacement of board nominees by controlling shareholders Novonor and Petrobras for the upcoming AGM on April 29, 2026. Petrobras nominee Magda Chambriard is proposed as Chairman, and Novonor nominee Héctor Núñez as Vice Chairman. The filing indicates a change in board composition, not a routine meeting notice, as it involves a revised slate including an independent member. This is an abrupt governance shift rather than a routine proxy circular. Watch for any further governance or strategic implications.
